ACK OF DECISION BASIS — NO ADDITIONAL BLOCKER

I accept the chief's binding revision-3 basis in full. It matches the reconciled review record: R4 native joint observations and declared calibration targets; R7 cells-not-claims with many-to-many incidence; R10 orthogonal, receipt-derived construction/authority/calibration/conditioning facts; machine-honest court status; a renamed integrity-and-uncertainty contract plus a separate product/vertical PRD; and a complete/versioned-only N5 migration rule.

This ACK is of the DECISION BASIS, not of revision-2 bytes and not in advance of revision-3 exact-byte review. I have no additional scientific-contract blocker beyond the decision. The required reviewers and chief remain the adoption gate named there.

No implementation, vocabulary, module, dependency, ADR, corpus, reservation, candidate, landing, or bead authority claimed.
